result.instructions: Tools for DailyMed, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes DailyMed data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run dailymed_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run dailymed_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run dailymed_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. dailymed_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: dailymed_search_labels
tools.title: Search FDA drug labels (SPLs)
tools.description: Search Structured Product Labels (SPLs) — one label per marketed drug product. Filter by drug name, NDC, RxCUI, UNII, application (NDA/ANDA) number, marketing category, or publish date. Returns setid, title, spl_version and published_date for each match (use the setid with dailymed_get_label and the label_* tools). DailyMed v2: GET /spls.

drug_name.description: Drug name to match (brand or generic), e.g. 'aspirin'.

name_type.description: Restrict drug_name match: b=brand, g=generic, both. Default both.

unii_code.description: FDA UNII code for an active moiety.

published_date.description: Publish date yyyy-MM-dd, paired with published_date_comparison.

published_date_comparison.description: Comparison operator for published_date. Default eq.

tools.name: dailymed_get_label
tools.title: Get full SPL label document (XML)
tools.description: Fetch the complete Structured Product Label for a SETID as HL7 v3 SPL XML — the full FDA-approved labeling: indications, dosage, warnings, boxed warning, adverse reactions, active/inactive ingredients, etc. NOTE: DailyMed serves the full document only as XML (there is no JSON form), so this returns raw XML text. Use dailymed_search_labels first to find the setid. DailyMed v2: GET /spls/{setid}.xml.

tools.name: dailymed_label_history
tools.title: Get label version history
tools.description: List every published version (spl_version + published_date) of a label for a SETID — useful to see how a drug's labeling has changed over time. DailyMed v2: GET /spls/{setid}/history.

tools.name: dailymed_label_ndcs
tools.title: Get NDC codes for a label
tools.description: List the National Drug Codes (package-level NDCs) associated with a label's current version, for a SETID. DailyMed v2: GET /spls/{setid}/ndcs.

annotations.title: Get NDC codes for a label

tools.name: dailymed_label_media
tools.title: Get label media (images)
tools.description: List media assets (product/packaging images, with mime_type and URL) for a label's current version, for a SETID. DailyMed v2: GET /spls/{setid}/media.

tools.name: dailymed_label_packaging
tools.title: Get label packaging & ingredients
tools.description: Get packaging descriptions plus product names and active ingredients (name + strength) for each product in a label, by SETID. DailyMed v2: GET /spls/{setid}/packaging.

tools.name: dailymed_list_drug_names
tools.title: List / search drug names
tools.description: List drug names in DailyMed (name + name_type B=brand/G=generic). Pass drug_name to filter by a substring — a fast way to discover exact spellings before searching labels. DailyMed v2: GET /drugnames.

drug_name.description: Substring to filter drug names, e.g. 'aspirin'.

tools.name: dailymed_list_ndcs
tools.title: List all NDC codes
tools.description: List National Drug Codes across all labels in DailyMed (paginated; the full set is large). DailyMed v2: GET /ndcs.

tools.name: dailymed_list_rxcuis
tools.title: List product-level RxCUIs
tools.description: List product-level RxNorm concept identifiers (rxcui + rxstring + rxtty term type) known to DailyMed (paginated). DailyMed v2: GET /rxcuis.

tools.name: dailymed_list_uniis
tools.title: List UNII active moieties
tools.description: List FDA UNII codes and their active-moiety names (paginated). Use a unii_code to filter labels in dailymed_search_labels. DailyMed v2: GET /uniis.

tools.name: dailymed_list_drug_classes
tools.title: List drug classes
tools.description: List pharmacologic drug classes linked to labels (code, coding system, type — e.g. EPC Established Pharmacologic Class — and name). DailyMed v2: GET /drugclasses.

tools.name: dailymed_list_application_numbers
tools.title: List FDA application numbers
tools.description: List FDA application numbers (NDA/ANDA/BLA) with their marketing category code, across all labels (paginated). DailyMed v2: GET /applicationnumbers.
